FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.text: If you have any further questions, feel free to contact us by phone at +998 77 124 44 44 or email us at rollingsushi@gmail.com.

questions.q0_answer:
You can order delivery in the following ways:
• Through our website: select dishes, add them to your cart, and place an order.
• Through the Rolling Sushi mobile app, available on the App Store and Google Play.
• By phone: +998 77 124 44 44.
questions.q1_question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.q1_answer:
We accept:
• Online payment via payment systems (Click, Payme, Uzum).
• Cash or card payment upon delivery.
• Using bonuses in combination with cash for payment.
questions.q2_question: How does the bonus system work?
questions.q2_answer:
• Bonuses are awarded for each order based on the customer’s level:
• Bronze (10%) from the 1st to the 4th order.
• Silver (20%) from the 5th to the 9th order.
• Gold (30%) from the 10th order onwards.
• Accumulated bonuses can be used for full or partial payment of dishes.
questions.q3_question: How long will the delivery take?
questions.q3_answer: The average delivery time is 40 minutes. The time may vary depending on your location and the workload.
questions.q4_question: How can I track the status of my order?
questions.q4_answer:
• After placing the order, you will receive a notification with the order number and its status.
• In the mobile app, you can see the current order status: “Accepted”, “Preparing”, “On the way”.
questions.q5_question: What should I do if my order is delayed?
questions.q5_answer: If your order is delayed, please contact us at +998 77 124 44 44. We will quickly check the status and provide you with the details.
questions.q6_answer:
• If the order hasn’t been started yet, you can cancel it without penalty.
• If the order is already ready or on its way, the cancellation may incur additional costs.
questions.q7_answer:
Our branches are located at the following addresses:
• Yakkasaray: Bogiston Street, House 7, Tashkent.
• Other addresses can be found in the “Contacts” section on our website.
questions.q8_answer: Yes, we offer vegetarian sushi and rolls. You can find them in the “Vegetarian Dishes” category on our website and app.
questions.q9_question: How can I leave a review?
questions.q9_answer:
You can leave a review:
• On our website in the “Reviews” section.
• Through the mobile app.
• In Google My Business to help us improve.
questions.q10_question: How to apply for a vacancy?
questions.q10_answer: You can submit an application through the “Careers” section on our website, providing your contact information and the position you are applying for.
questions.q11_answer: If you have any further questions, feel free to contact us at +998 77 124 44 44 or email us at rollingsushi@gmail.com.

description.0_text: This Privacy Policy describes how Rolling Sushi (hereinafter referred to as 'Company') collects, uses, stores, and protects customer information.
description.1_title: Data Collection We may collect the following data:
description.1_text:
• Personal data: name, surname, phone number, email address. 
• Delivery data: delivery address, additional comments.
• Payment information: transaction data (but not bank card details).
• Technical data: IP address, device data, browser type, cookies.
description.2_title: Data Usage Collected data may be used for:
description.2_text:
• Processing and fulfilling orders. 
• Improving service quality and personalizing offers.
• Communicating with customers to confirm orders or inform them about delivery status.
• Conducting marketing campaigns and loyalty programs.
description.3_title: Data Sharing with Third Parties We do not share customers' personal data with third parties except in the following cases:
description.3_text:
• To fulfill delivery via partner services.
• To process payments through payment systems.
• As required by the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description.4_title: Data Protection We take all necessary measures to protect customer data:
description.4_text:
• Use SSL encryption for data transmission.
• Regularly update security systems to prevent unauthorized access.
